injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.
McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
